title: Grok Build and OpenCode CLIs are installed on this development machine
body: Run Grok Build and OpenCode checks directly: both CLIs are installed on this machine (`grok` 1.0.25 and `opencode` 1.16.2 when recorded on 2026-09-19; `which grok` and `which opencode` resolve). Useful: `grok inspect` (lists the instructions, skills, hooks and MCP servers discovered for the current project), `grok plugin validate <path>` (validates a plugin manifest and lists its components) and `opencode debug startup` (loads the configured plugins, including a local file:// path, and says whether startup completed without an import-time crash). Prefer them to assuming a harness integration can only be checked by hand. Why: the 2026-09-19 install plan had treated both as manual, probably unavailable steps; both were present and gave real signal.
not_derivable: What is installed on the development machine is recorded nowhere in the repository.

evidence.summary: grok 1.0.25 installed and working against this repository, including auto-discovery of skills/ (2026-09-19).
opencode 1.16.2 installed and working, including resolving a local file:// plugin path (2026-09-19).
